name: cluster-accounts-quality-judge
description: Clustering output should produce non-generic unified messages tailored to the segment's shared characteristics.

expectations.rubric: A great unifiedValueMessage references the shared characteristic that binds this segment (dev-tools scale-up dynamics, engineering velocity metrics, etc.) and offers a specific value angle — not a generic 'we help you grow' message.

A great coordinated outreach angle names a specific campaign type or hook (e.g. 'CTO-focused webinar on scaling engineering velocity metrics past 200 devs'). Vague marketing-speak like 'targeted outreach' scores low.
